Think of an earnings calendar as your roadmap to upcoming company financial reports. Publicly traded companies release earnings reports quarterly, detailing their financial performance, including revenue, profits, and future outlooks. The earnings calendar lists these reports by company, date, and sometimes even estimated earnings per share (EPS).

## Why is the Earnings Calendar Important? [...] Earnings reports offer a window into a company's financial health. Strong earnings can boost investor confidence, leading to a rise in stock price.
